chunks.heading: Details of each Segment
chunks.text:
Rainfall Forecast: 29 May – 04 June 2025 - Rainfall is likely to be above normal in the west coast of India and NE India. Rainfall is likely to be below normal in Interior Karnataka, Rayalseema and Tamil Nadu. No rainfall activity in Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, West U.P., Saurashtra-Kutch, most parts of Tamil Nadu, NIK and Rayalseema. 05 June – 12 June 2025 - Rainfall is likely to be below normal in most of India. No rainfall activity in Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, Gujarat, U.P. and M.P.
| 4 Advance of Southwest Monsoon: - The Southwest Monsoon has set in over Kerala on 24th May, 2025, against the normal date of 1st June. Southwest monsoon has covered Lakshadweep area, Kerala, Mahe, Karnataka, remaining parts of Maldives and Comorin area; Tamil Nadu, Goa, many parts of Maharashtra (including Mumbai), Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, some parts of Chhattisgarh & Odisha, entire Northeastern states and some parts of Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and entire Sikkim till 29th May, 2025. - Conditions are favourable for further advance of southwest monsoon over some more parts of West Bengal and Bihar during next 1-2 days. - Southwest Monsoon likely to advance over some more parts of East & central India during subsequent days till week 2 ending 11 June, 2025.

chunks.heading: 2. TEMPERATURE: MIN & MAX
chunks.text:
| 5 Temerature Week 1 (30th May - 05 June 2025): - Maximum Temperature is likely to be below normal in most parts of India except in Bihar. - Heat Wave: Isolated places over West Rajasthan. Week 2 ( 06 June - 12 June 2025): - Maximum temperature is likely to be above normal in East and NE India and likely to be below normal over the rest of India. Forecast for the 2025 Southwest Monsoon Rainfall over the Country as a Whole - Quantitatively, the southwest monsoon seasonal rainfall over the country as a whole is likely to be 106% of the long-period average (LPA) with a model error of ± 4%. - Thus, above normal rainfall is most likely over the country as a whole during the monsoon season (June to September), 2025.

chunks.heading: CROP SOWING STATUS FOR RABI SEASON
chunks.text: Summer Crops - Area coverage - As per 3rd Advance Estimates 2024-25, about 114.2 percent of the normal area has been sown under the summer season crops. - Rice: About 35.86 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 30.18 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. - Pulses: About 23.50 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 21.41 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. - Oilseeds: About 8.88 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 8.27 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
